title: PVL: Creamline overwhelms Farm Fresh in Siklab Finals opener

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Creamline showed first-time finalist Farm Fresh how it is done, using its championship experience to dominate Game 1 of the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series Finals with a 25-11, 25-16, 25-16 rout on Saturday at Philsports Arena. The Finals stage is clearly Creamline’s playground, schooling the Foxies in their 16th championship appearance and 10th straight in the All-Filipino Conference in front of a pink-clad crowd.
